scope: Independent Octave coupled RK4 of the approved two-time-scale model: 8 native LF states + 12 original hydroVessel WF states + 2 servo states. LF uses actual S175 rigid mass/inertia and Groll with source Son-Nomoto hull force, source convective terms and physical actuator loads. WF uses pinned hydroVessel.m with full MSS M, MA, D, G, Coriolis, crossflow, zero current and the held first-order wave-force tape only. External LF wind, mean surge and current are held inputs. Exposed composition follows the root integration contract. This is not a full-model validation claim.
limitations: Bounded 10 s trajectories. Direct cases use held open-loop actuator orders; the runtime case records actual controller orders and held wind/wave/mean/current tapes, so it validates dynamics, clock, servo and composition but not the independently tuned PID decision logic. The two-time-scale WF slow-frame feedback approximation remains a documented limitation. No coefficient fitting was used.
case_descriptions: 6.214 m/s positive LF turn with heel and a nonzero oscillatory WF heave/pitch/roll/translation state
5 m/s negative LF turn with opposite heel and a signed WF translation/rotation perturbation
3 m/s moderate turn with large WF translation, heave and pitch but a bounded actuator envelope
6.214 m/s negative LF turn with large negative heel and nonzero WF roll/pitch/heave
Actual Simulation.advance with s175_maneuvering; recorded controller orders and held wind/wave/mean/current tapes
